messages:
marta (Finance Ops): Heads-up: March batch produced anomalies. acct-blue (acct_blue) received two invoices; one PDF is missing the reserved-capacity prorate line. vendor-contour got a vendor credit applied twice. Can billing/ETL triage?

oliver (Billing Eng): Please paste invoice IDs and a tiny ledger snippet. I'll scan writer logs for duplicate writes and batch UUIDs.

marta (Finance Ops): inv_2034_0301_blue and inv_2034_0301_blue-duplicate. Contour inv_2034_0301_ctr. Snippet: {"acct":"acct_blue","lines":[],"credits":[{"id":"vcred_A12","amount":-250}]}

liam (Data Eng): Checked exporter logs around 2025-03-01T00:12Z: saw `exporter: omitted_zero_prorate` then a transient DB error and retry for same batch_id. Likely the filter removed zero-usage prorates before the write; retry created a second invoice row without lines. Rerunning extract for affected accounts now.

tara (CS): Customer reported both PDFs and is worried about duplicate charges. Please pause collections for acct_blue and advise on ETA so we can respond.

oliver (Billing Eng): I'll void the spurious invoice after we confirm the re-import and regenerate corrected PDFs. Need finance sign-off to void duplicate invoice record. Also opening rollback PR for the filter and adding idempotent write behavior.

marta (Finance Ops): Approved to void duplicate invoice once corrected PDF is ready. Action list: liam finish re-run; oliver void+regen PDFs and open rollback PR; tara pause dunning and notify customer. Target: corrected PDFs and customer note within 3 hours.

deploy-bot: billing-engine v3.7.2 deployed 2025-03-01T00:10:21Z (includes PR #688 `skip-zero-prorates`). Potential correlation.
